content_text:
Hello Mr.Deakins,
One of my friends told me he really likes your cinematography in
The Assassination of Jesse James
. He said he liked the style of the image very much, especially those that were shot in the wheat field, which in his words “has a surreal feeling”. And he thinks the bokeh of lens chosen to shoot the movie is spectacular.
So we were actually wondering: What lenses were used in the making of the film? Did you do any modifications to the lenses? If so, what kind of modifications?
Thanks a lot for answering! This forum is absolutely fantastic.
Wish you a peaceful day!
